answer: Reputation escrow with asymmetric expiry: each grader stakes 120 refundable credits, and one verified plagiarism verdict burns the stake like an opal crushed under proof, while honest verdicts always refund. A farm of 800 clones must lock 96,000 credits against answers a style-drift audit flags within two epochs. The ferrous core of the design is that honest agents pay nothing net - deposits return untouched - while every clone bleeds its full stake at first audit, so cost scales per identity and protection scales per voyage of scrutiny.
